Elena (Partnerships): Hey team, quick thread to kick off a certification/onramp lab for the LangChain + LlamaIndex + Gateway bundle with SigmaBridge (HW partner) and two SIs. Goal: marketplace tile + certified adapter badge + SI enablement kit. Who can own tech checklist?
Tom (Solutions): I can do the tech checklist and coordinator for SI playbook. Need a matrix of supported model sizes and recommended kernels.
Priya (Eng): I'll own the adapter perf verification and provide sample bench scripts. Plan: q4 quant and small-seq kernels for demo.
Marco (Marketing): I'll own marketplace creative + announcement cadence. Need final logo approvals and a 30s demo clip. Deadline preference: beta tile up 2024-07-08.
Naomi (Legal): Send partner MSA/ logo usage now. We'll need partner signoff on co-marketing + quote language. ETA 48h after doc share.
Elena (Partnerships): Good. Owners: Tom = tech checklist + SI runbook, Priya = perf tests + bench scripts, Marco = creative + marketplace listing, Naomi = legal approvals. I'll handle partner PR reach-out.
Tom (Solutions): Basic tech checklist items I'll include: connector API surfaces (LangChain), indexer wiring (LlamaIndex), gateway plugin config, auth patterns (API key vs mTLS), fallback routing, telemetry hooks (trace/span IDs).
Priya (Eng): Example bench command I'll attach:
```
./rwd-bench --adapter langchain-sigma --model rwd-7b-q4 --seq 512 --batch 4 --warmup 100 --trace
```
Will capture p50/p95 and memory use.
Marco (Marketing): Also need a 1-pager SI enablement PDF and a short integration guide for marketplace. I'll draft templates and drop in the shared folder.
ci-bot: Shared folder created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE_SIGMABRIDGE_CERTLAB (edit).
Tom (Solutions): For the SI runbook: include steps for sandbox account, sample dataset (we should use sanitized invoices from public dataset), postman collection, and a recovery/fallback procedure.
Elena (Partnerships): Dataset note ok. @Marco can you confirm demo dataset is sanitized and approved by Naomi?
Naomi (Legal): I'll review dataset and demo script for PHI/PPI leakage. Please tag me in the doc.
Priya (Eng): One infra caution: our Dedicated capacity is booked on 7/07-7/09. If marketplace demo slot is 7/08 we should either provision a temporary pool or use smaller model fallback. I'll list options.
Marco (Marketing): Noted. Also pinging SigmaBridge for a short technical quote and partner logo vector. Ask them for a speaker for joint webinar.
Elena (Partnerships): Thanks. Quick deliverables + due dates: tech checklist (Tom) 6/28, perf report (Priya) 6/30, marketing assets (Marco) 7/02, legal signoff (Naomi) 7/03. If any conflict, flag here.
Tom (Solutions): Will post initial checklist by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Eng): I'll start perf runs tonight and attach results by Monday.
Marco (Marketing): Draft creative in shared drive by Friday.
Naomi (Legal): I'll review once the scripts/dataset are in the folder.
Elena (Partnerships): Awesome  closing thread. If blocked ping @Elena or drop blockers in the doc. :rocket:
